title: D2P Expression Node
description: Typed expression AST of the pattern module (design decision ADR-006.1). The node list is closed: there are no scripts, strings, user-defined functions, loops or recursion. Every node is an object with a required 'op' and only the members listed for its kind. Dimensions are tracked as integer exponent pairs (length, angle); the dimension check, the depth limit (64) and the node limit (1024 per expr) are semantic checks (D2P-SEM-002, D2P-SEM-003). Evaluation uses IEEE-754 binary64 in node order.

exprNode.title: Expression node
exprNode.description: Any expression node. Exactly one of the six closed node kinds, selected by 'op'. An object whose 'op' is missing or outside the closed list is rejected (refined to D2P-STR-010).

literalNode.title: Literal node
literalNode.description: A numeric literal with its unit. Dimension (1,0) for mm, (0,1) for rad, (0,0) for the dimensionless unit "1".

value.description: The literal value, in the canonical unit given by 'unit'.

name.description: Name of the constant. Only "pi" exists in feature set 1.0.0.

paramNode.title: Parameter node
paramNode.description: Reference to a pattern parameter. Its dimension is the parameter's declared dimension. Creates a dependency edge in the feature graph.

parameterId.description: Element ID of a parameter of the same pattern.

measurementNode.title: Measurement node
measurementNode.description: Reference to a measurement input of the pattern. Its dimension is the dimension of the input's measurement definition.

key.description: Key of an entry in the pattern's 'measurementInputs'.

featureOutputNode.title: Feature output node
featureOutputNode.description: Reference to a named output of a feature of the same pattern (for example 'x', 'y', 'length', 'angle', 'radius', 'sweep'). Its dimension is the declared dimension of that output. An unknown output is D2P-REF-004.

featureId.description: Element ID of the feature whose output is read.

output.description: Name of the output, as defined for the feature type (feature set 1.0.0) or declared by its feature capability.

operatorNode.title: Operator node
operatorNode.description: An operator applied to argument nodes. Arity per operator: add, mul, min, max, and, or take at least 2 arguments; sub, div, atan2, lt, le, gt, ge exactly 2; neg, abs, sqrt, sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, not exactly 1; clamp (value, lower, upper) and if (condition, a, b) exactly 3. Typing rules are stated in §3.2.4 of the schema catalog.

op.description: Operator name from the closed list of 24 operators.

args.description: Argument nodes, in operator order. The exact count depends on 'op'.

exprValue.title: Expression value
exprValue.description: The {expr} wrapper used for every expression-valued slot (feature parameters, seam allowances, constraint values, seam ease amounts). The expected dimension comes from the slot.

expr.description: The expression. It MUST NOT evaluate to a boolean.
